beats.label: hook
beats.text: The 5 biggest games dropping before Christmas. Number 1 has been in development for 8 years.

beats.label: items_5_to_3
beats.text: Number 5. LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight. TT Games' most ambitious project, Batman's full origin story across six distinct eras. Number 4. Crimson Desert. Pearl Abyss spent six years on this open world RPG, five million sold in its first month. Number 3. Marathon. Bungie's PvPvE extraction shooter, where you die and lose everything you brought in.

beats.label: items_2_to_1
beats.text: Number 2. EA Sports UFC 6. Markerless capture tech rebuilds every fighter's strikes, with a Flow State mechanic that unlocks signature moves. And number 1. Subnautica 2. Eight years after the original, the same studio is back with co-op multiplayer underwater survival.

beats.label: cta
beats.text: Five games. Five different reasons to clear your calendar before December. Which one are you actually excited for?
